state.goal: Choose the first ready-made Python agent runtime to experimentally validate, not the final production architecture. Modular personal assistant; few core tools, deferred discovery, configurable model providers, multimodal content, persistent conversation plus event-driven durable continuation. No custom new framework or upstream patch. TypeSafe Jev handles semantic choices.

pydantic_ai.deferred_tools: FunctionToolset.defer_loading and automatic ToolSearch; custom search callable supported
pydantic_ai.persistence: message history can be stored separately; durable engines or backend builder available; cloud recovery not yet tested
pydantic_ai.limits: proxy compatibility and real tool round trip untested

langgraph.persistence: persistent checkpoints for thread state, stores for long term memory; resume and fault tolerance documented
langgraph.limits: deferred tool integration and model/proxy compatibility not tested in this task

existing_adk.existing_project: agent eagerly loads all tools; current model configuration assumes Google; heavy embeddings share package; redesign required, not necessarily inherent SDK limitation

state.rule: Unknown is not unsupported. Choose which small live spike should run first based only on evidence; do not declare production readiness.

first_spike.instructions: Which ready-made runtime should be tested first for the goal, minimizing new framework code while addressing deferred tools and TypeSafe decisions?

criteria.pydantic_ai: Use the documented deferred tools and TypeSafe integration, test the real proxy and persistence boundaries.
criteria.langgraph: Start with graph checkpointing and compose the necessary tool selection and model integrations.
criteria.existing_adk: Start by upgrading and restructuring the existing ADK-based code.
criteria.insufficient_evidence: No candidate has enough evidence even to choose a first bounded experimental spike.
